class.name: Node3D
class.brief_description: A node with a position, rotation, and scale in 3D space.
class.description: The local transform is relative to the direct parent when it is a Node3D. Otherwise, it is also the world transform. Rotation values use degrees.

method.name: SetLocalTransform
method.description: Sets the position, rotation, and scale from a matrix in local space.
method.param: The transform relative to the direct Node3D parent, or to the world if there is no Node3D parent.

method.name: GetLocalTransform
method.description: Gets the matrix for this node's local position, rotation, and scale.
method.returns: The transform relative to the direct Node3D parent, or to the world if there is no Node3D parent.

method.name: SetLocalPosition
method.description: Sets the position in local space.
method.param: The position relative to the direct Node3D parent, or to the world if there is no Node3D parent.

method.name: GetLocalPosition
method.description: Gets the position in local space.
method.returns: The position relative to the direct Node3D parent, or to the world if there is no Node3D parent.

method.name: SetLocalOrientation
method.description: Sets the rotation in local space.
method.param: The yaw, pitch, and roll angles in degrees, relative to the direct Node3D parent.

method.name: GetLocalOrientation
method.description: Gets the rotation in local space.
method.returns: The local yaw, pitch, and roll angles in degrees.

method.name: SetLocalScale
method.description: Sets the scale in local space.
method.param: The scale on each local axis. A value of 1 keeps the size on that axis.

method.name: GetLocalScale
method.description: Gets the scale in local space.
method.returns: The scale on each local axis.
